title: tests/kernel/test_aead.c: in-kernel tests for gcm(aes) and ccm(aes)
description: Kernel module testing AES-GCM and AES-CCM AEAD registrations. Tests must cover: NIST encrypt vectors with zero-length AAD; NIST encrypt vectors with non-zero AAD; decrypt vectors (verify tag, compare plaintext); tampered ciphertext (flip one byte) must return -EBADMSG; variable tag sizes 4, 8, 12, 16 bytes for GCM; CCM nonce sizes 7, 11, 13 bytes. Print 'wolfkm_test: gcm(aes) vector N [description]: PASS/FAIL' per check.
design: Use crypto_alloc_aead() and aead_request_alloc(). GCM AAD is prepended to the SGL (kernel convention — read include/crypto/aead.h). Set assoclen in the aead_request. For tampered-ciphertext test: copy encrypted output, flip one bit in the ciphertext body (not the tag), attempt decrypt, verify -EBADMSG. See DESIGN.md §aead and tests/vectors/aes_gcm.h.
acceptance_criteria: All vectors PASS. Tampered ciphertext returns -EBADMSG (not -EINVAL or 0). Variable tag sizes all work. Module unloads cleanly.
